What do you think, Darling?
Is it to your liking?

I don't like you looking there.
I-it's embarrassing…

W-what did she… say?
#C236196003Caster#CDEF? Embarrassed? No―――
Is everything starting to glitch out…!?

Let's keep this energy up until an
"oopsie" happens between us!
…that was close.

By the way, Darling.
Um… I want to hear what you really think.
It's―――utterly adorable.

It appears my fears were groundless.
Hmmmm, I see, I see.
…hey, wait a second.

Hehehe.
That bit is my desire to be blinded by love鷙

#C236196003Caster#CDEF is happier than usual.
Her tail is waving back and forth.

Yeahhh… ahaha…
I'm happy to hear you call me a "deity,"
but it also makes me sad.
#C236196003Caster#CDEF tries to fool me with a phony "ohohoho."
What's this fox so excited about…?
So, let's continue to take them on鷙

Kya!
The power of our love is COSMIC!
It's bonkers. Totally bonkers!

You've been training day in and day out,
Darling. Please, accept this gift from #C236196003Tamamo#CDEF.

―――Ahhh! My ears!
They're not for tugging…!

For all your hard work,
I'd like to support you with a gift.
Please take it.

"Major achievement"?
What the heck did I do?

You've proven mastery of my strengths and
brought out my best.

…hm… I wonder if I can be both the partner

#C236196003Caster#CDEF's tail hangs dejectedly.
What's the deal…?

R-really?
I'm helpful?

Ah, and if you'll allow it…
I can show you that side of me, but in bed?
That might be easier, actually.☆
"What kind of hero was #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF?"

It's true, of course.
The #C000246204SE.RA.PH#CDEF's records are objective facts.
How they're interpreted is up to the reader.
Were you really a tyrant…?
…created to be so?
#C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF said "ancient gods and modern gods."
…however.

"Created" sounds a bit unsettling.
It's sort of, like, unbefitting of #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF…

You heard that? It's not befitting of me…
I think so too, but it's true.
I was created by the gods' design.

The gods didn't create me to support humans.
They needed me because they feared humans.

Those were the circumstances of my birth.
Unlike all of you, I didn't come to be from
living an honest life.
#C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF speaks indifferently and cynically.

His look carries scornful animosity towards the gods,
but no disdain at all towards himself.

And isn't that the "self" that you and I have?
No matter if one's body is crafted, or if
one was someone else's copy to begin with.

If that's true,
then I can accept #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF's legend more.

Yes. I didn't heed their intent.
Though I WAS created, I was a born as a new
form of life. And if that was the case―――

Then there was no sense in supporting
the ideas of some old gods.
I lived as I saw fit.

I decreed myself king and ascertained what
I saw as the right way to rule. That's all.

I governed over Uruk because it pleased me.
The gods' intent took no part in it.
I wound up getting his #C000246204SG#CDEF!

Were I to reincarnate, I'd pump blood as a man,
but my heart would rouse only for those of my
era. I don't see that changing here.

Hence, I'm only taking a nice tour of the
#C000246204SE.RA.PH#CDEF. I'll pay you with a secret for
having escorted me.
…not one bit.

In all seriousness, why does such an absurd
Servant even exist…?

Hm? Your complexion doesn't look so bad,
but your vitals are dropping.
I awoke in the wilderness.
Suddenly, I heard a far-off call.
Curious about that call, I lifted my heavy eyelids.
I had just awoken, but I was not rational.
"O chain. Bring the lynchpin back to us."
I lacked human will.
…however.

I learned wisdom and reason.
She taught me of how Heaven and Earth work.
"#C236196003Enkidu#CDEF."

My role.
My mission.

My reason for being.
My reason for being created.
My reason to risk my life.

Unlike me, he seems to grow.
Unlike me, human blood is mixed within him.

Until he becomes an adult,
I can't compete with him.
Unless we fight on equal terms,
it won't count as admonishment.
―――And so, I gazed upon the fortress city.

Arrogance? I could only think that the gods had been mistaken.
The child #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF had no shortcomings worthy of admonishment.

The people of Uruk grieved.
"Why has it come to this?"
…what a powerful ego.
"You? Admonish me?"
Our battle lasted several days.
I was a spear; an axe; a shield; a beast.
Finally―――Who had won the battle?

Regardless, I heard his words, then followed
his lead and collapsed as he did.
I even thought, "just like a mirror."
"Do you regret having to use your treasures?"
For some reason, I asked this.
So said #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF, in a cheerful voice.

"Ever since you came, my stores have been busy.
You made me develop this stupid habit of
throwing my treasures around."
"Fool."
"Listen――. That means――. Got it?"

He went on.

As he did, I heard words as precious as the stars.
This was the moment where I truly had a "self."

"I won't forgive them! Why must you die?
If punishment must be rendered, lay it unto me!
Was this crime born not from my own selfishness?"

The sky still cries.
Unable to see, I make to him a suggestion.
I admired him for that. Despised him all the same.

We were created by the same father.
Why were we such different creatures?

"You have worth. A unique worth.
Thus, I say: in this world, I have but one friend.
That's why――
your worth won't change, not for all of eternity."

I was a weapon.
Weapons are made to be replaced every generation.
My worth, my mystique, existed only in this era.

At the cost of being alone forever,
he made me something else.
"Fool."

He knew his weaknesses, but wouldn't change them.
He knew his strengths, but wouldn't flatter them.

Across this man's pride,
I left an all-unhealing wound.
My records end here.
I'm a regret which has already vanished.

…I squint from the light.
It seems I was having an old dream.

I happen to look up and see #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF
pressing his eyelids with his fingers.

………it appears so.
Apparently, I was a tad tired as well.
I saw something trivial yet nostalgic.
Maybe he had been experiencing the same dream I had.

I have to ask.
#C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF, his contractor, asks him―――
Do I resemble your friend?
Is it true? Does Gil love humans?

I never even had any, first of all.
Even if I did have one, I've forgotten their
name, for I can no longer speak it.
"I can no longer speak it."

Moron. In my past, I've never had
even one acquaintance who resembles
a half-wit like yourself.

You're the one and only you.
Don't feed me every bit of nonsense that
comes to your mind.
…those words just made me really happy.

How do I see humans!? Look at how I treated you
and figure it out! Don't ask me something
so obvious!

If I were to do as he said, it would be obvious
as to what his stance on humans is.

It's far from the truth about me.
Bear that in mind.
Saying this, #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF leaves ahead of me.
I also hurry out of bed and run after his golden back.
I finally looked into the last part of #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF's legend.
Okay, so―――
――――What?

I see. So this means you read until the
end of my epic. I won't ask why
you pose that question then.
I should――
…wait, hold on a second.

It must be the same for my childhood self.
If he knew what he would become, then perhaps
he would seek to stop his own development.
Is this the root of who #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF is…?

Until then, I had never mourned a death
or feared death. I wasn't even aware of such
things.

Still, someone as powerful as me was now
gone. I knew death came for all, but that's
when I first felt it.
"Someone as powerful as me" must be referring to #C236196003Enkidu#CDEF.

Of course, it's not as if I WASN'T thinking
about the plant of eternal youth and life.
I needed one for my treasury for completion.

It was a task I would've had to undertake
whether they returned to dust or not.
Also, I had found a reason.

Still, even my folly surpasses what you humans
possess. …disgracefully, I swallowed my
shame and pressed on.
He speaks nostalgically.

He probably really was afraid of death.
But that only serves as one reason.

When I reached the underworld, I asked the sage
about the secret of eternal youth and life.

The sage must have become timid after
denying his own being.
He had passed onto me his secret.

"I know that you do not obey the gods."
"I won't ask of you to beg Anu for mercy."
"Instead――I will share with you a secret."

An elixir of eternal youth and life would
exhibit well in my treasury. I descended the
abyss, bottled up the plant, and resurfaced.

I let a serpent have the miracle plant.
That conceited vermin snatched my
eternal life while I was bathing.

I've always endorsed desire. And it came back
to bite me, in the form of a slithering
serpent's mere appetite.
That's it.

The legend states that the snake stole
the miracle plant from #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF.

Yet in the end, I was but a son of man….
That's all. I was young and reckless.

If I had to confess, that was my first taste of
joy. Collecting treasure is instinct to me.
Akin to breathing. It brings me no joy.

I celebrated such facts as my possession of
a human perspective. Until that moment,
I hadn't been human.

In the end, I had nothing left―――
I came to understand that THIS was my one and
only reward for completing my work.

I had no need for eternal life. My eyes have
always been able to see the future.
I never had any reason to fear death.

Sorry. I said before that was I born complete,
but that was incorrect. There was a period
where I was naive.

I looked up at the wide expanse of the sky.
Even with my eyes, it took many moons to
see through it.

…and I saw that future.
It was a galvanizing sight.
I think I then lost my will to go on.
That how #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF's journey ended.

Compared to the truth he came to realize at that moment,
the miracle plant was but a trifle.
He got more!?

Hmph. Come now.
Collecting treasure is instinct to me.
Just let it be.
…anyway, now I finally get the picture.

Oh? Could that look be one of reverence?
Very well. Feast your eyes. I can change into
another outfit if you'd like.
No way!
I never make embarrassing emotional outbursts like her!

#C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF's words stab me like a spear.
How could I even GAIN weight…
when I'm paired up with this guy…!

Of course, there's no use in appraising the
spoils of war just yet. She's after YOU.

#C236196003BB#CDEF. How far will that woman get on my nerves?
To send me such a vulgar #RUBS   program#RUBEtechnique#REND…!

I didn't expect #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF to catch me
looking at him unimpressed.

I was wrong, AUO!
I will NEVER look at you unimpressed ever again!
I shake my head with all I have, "Not at all."

You're the one who told me to curl up!
What a brilliant change of mind!

So, dungeon exploring all the time is tedious,

#C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF.

……huh?
Rin
Rani

Leo
Julius
Gatou
Gilgamesh

Why am I taking damage from this?

…oh yeah.
I need to think about defeating #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF.

First thing is to defeat #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF…!
#C236196003BB#CDEF had her usual enthusiasm in that previous broadcast.

#C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF's eyes pierce me.

Waku Waku Splash?

Oh boy………
I feel bad for cheery #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF.

…he's pitying me.
He's actually pitying me.
He's straight up, ACTUALLY PITYING ME!

That battle was unexpectedly entertaining.
Mongrel as you may be, if this is your caliber,

"Rares"…?
Ah, those rare enemies.
Right, I took them all down.

I can't believe it.
#C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF? Praising ME?

I notice #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF seemingly flaunting

This barren treasury is how this pauper gets by.

……………
……………

H-he's crying over THIS!?

Heh… hehehe…. hehehehehe…
I've saved up… and quite a bit…

Behold!
NOW you may kneel before your Master!

Hm? Did something happen to your stores?
………
………well, well.

…I won.
A total blowout.

Or what?

I get it, that makes sense.

AS IF!
…okay. Saving up this small amount won't cut it.

Hm? Very well…
I see some sizable weight now compared

I did it. I did it. IdiditIdiditIdiditIdidit.
At last, I made my comeback against #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF!

I was right to assign you to fixing the

…hm?
That sounded a bit strange.

I didn't quite get what I was expecting,

???

…oh, I didn't know…
Accordingly, I've used just as many Code Casts―――

…so, basically:

Como esta será nossa base daqui em diante,

linhas.en:
#C236196003#SVT#CDEF clears #SVT[her][his][her][his]# throat with an "ahem"
and calmly begins to speak to #SVT[her][his][her][his]# amateur of a Master.

#RUBS  Master#RUBEPraetor#REND.
I never had any proof to back this up, but…
You've lost your memories, haven't you?
#C236196003Saber#CDEF looks at me with suspicion, which pains me terribly.

…I see.
Even without my memories,
my body seems to remember all the time we spent together.
Being the cause of that expression on her face
is enough to make me feel awful.

So it's true…
It's sad, but don't let it get you so down.
You're being honest with me. I'm glad.

My memories are fragmented,
and a sense of discomfort wells up within me.

Truthfully, as I am now, I can't remember even who I am.
There's definite proof that I fought together with #C236196003Saber#CDEF
in the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF, but my detailed memories
are like the sights beyond a thick mist.

…is that right? You have the same expression
as the Praetor I remember―――
In that case, I must also confess something.

I think we heard this from #C236196003Gawain#CDEF:
my memory isn't complete either.

I get the feeling that what you lack is
for a deliberate purpose, but what I lack is
for a functional purpose.

…just a hunch, though. It may be the case that
when a Servant enters the #C000246204Far Side of the Moon#CDEF,
memories gained in the Near Side are erased.

…I had no idea.
Though I understand, #C236196003Saber#CDEF's confession came as a shock.

Even #C236196003#SVT#CDEF has lost memories, not just me.
This means we've both reverted back to the moment we met.

Could it be that #C236196003Saber#CDEF's memories
and my memories of us fighting alongside each other
are lost forever―――

Hey! Don't make that face! I so badly want to
hug you for some reason! My memory is
hazy too, so don't stress me!

…mhm. At any rate, this means we must start
all over again, Praetor.

From this point on, I shall determine if you're
fit to be my Master.

The answer will come in the end. Rest for now.
Recover from your fatigue. Starting tomorrow,
our daily routine begins.
I answer #C236196003Archer#CDEF's question honestly, albeit with hesitation.

I can't lie to him.
Even without my full memory, my body pleads to me not to do so.

Truthfully, as I am now, I don't have definite
proof of even who I am.

I have memories of fighting alongside him
in the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF, but no matter
how hard I try, I see only clouded scenes.

So #C236196003Archer#CDEF says while crossing his arms in his usual smug pose.
He finds enjoyment in this.

W-what's with that look!? Why are you lifting
that chair? You going to swing it?
You want to swing it at me?
I mean, he says that he forgot…
All memories of his Master up until now, so…

Seriously!? You're not trying to make me
remember by smacking me…!? Did you even
forget how to act like a lady!?

Ah, well, from the beginning you
never really were a―――
Personal punishments are now over.

My memory may be hazy, but I just couldn't
feel satisfied without a little protest.
Truly, the human body is filled with secrets and mysteries.

…anyway, let's sort things out.
Honestly, just like you, I have some spots
where my memory is vague.

I recall our battles in the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF,
but my memories are obscure, as if bits
and pieces were erased.

Someone intended for you to have memory loss,
while my case is a natural result. It's not
reasonable to consider us the same.

For Servants, going from the Near Side to the
Far Side may be impossible in and of itself.
I'm lucky to just have some burnt memory.

…I was prepared for this after hearing it from #C236196003Gawain#CDEF,
but #C236196003Archer#CDEF's confession still came as a shock.

Yet, despite all that, #C236196003Archer#CDEF's gaze hasn't a glint of worry.
It glows with a strong sense of trust.

At any rate, we'll both just have to redo this
all over again. An amateur Master and a
nameless Heroic Spirit…

Even so, as long as you trust yourself
and the Servant you chose, the things you need
to do won't change.
#C236196003Archer#CDEF's voice beams with confidence.

In the face of his reliability, I nod in reply,
brimming with determination too.

Now then, rest up and prepare for tomorrow.
No time to mess around.
Life is about training daily.

Those few words send a sharp pain through me.
Now that I think about it, why haven't I told her
about this yet?

Even without my memories,
my body seems to remember all the time we spent together.

…I should be the one apologizing.
#C236196003Caster#CDEF, concerned for her Master,
knew she wouldn't like what she'd hear,
but still dove into the issue.

…it's not too late, even now.
I confess honestly.
About how I currently can't even remember who I am.

About how I remember fighting in the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF with #C236196003Caster#CDEF,
but not any vivid details, no matter how much I try.

Ah, that's not the case. Darling is Darling,
memories or not鷙 Please have confidence
in that. Be like, "YEAH!"

Mikon!? N-no, no. Just talking to myself!
More importantly, erm, this is unfortunate!

As a wife, it makes me so sad… *sob, sob, sob*.
And we were so intimate, so close that
other Servants were envious… *peek*.

#C236196003Caster#CDEF hides her face in the hem of her Western clothes
and breaks down crying.
*sob, sob, sob*

…*tsk*.
That way of reacting is the one most
important thing you DO recall, I see.

I have to give it to you Darling, you've got
iron self-control.
You're tough, even with hazy memory.

Now, it's time for me to confess.
Sooo, to be honest… erm, it seems that I've
forgotten various things too. Tee-hee.

I still have memories of our battles in the
#C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF. However, bits and pieces
are vague for me.

Ah, I already figured out the cause.
Servants, by design, are not made for
traveling from the Near Side to the Far Side.

Typically, they get burnt to cinders. I
think I was fortunate―only a portion of my
memory got toasted.

But, it appears that my Darling's memory loss
is a separate matter. No doubt that a scoundrel
had some hand in this!

My case is grave, but #C236196003Caster#CDEF took that into
consideration with a smile and an "it's alright."

Let's look on the bright side, Darling.
We can refoster our love from the beginning!
One could see this as lucky!

Ehehe… soooo, let's get cozy in bed toget―
Huh? Why is my pillow in the corner? "At least
hold back on the first day, pink fox"?

Come onnnnnn!
This is no fun, Darlliinnnggg!

Outside the window, it's nighttime.
This must be proof that we're not connected
to the school building right now.

Here, we can talk about things we don't
want others listening to.
linhas.pt:
Aqui podemos falar de coisas que não
queremos que ninguém escute.

linhas.en:
What a shabby room. A far cry from
a bedchamber a king would rest in,
but it's suitable for you.

Then again, the best part of any journey is
throwing around insults in a cheap lodge.
Very well―I have no discontent with this.

I'll use this seat. You may curl up and sleep
in that corner of the room where I nicely
can't see you.

The old me would've probably obeyed
him and his haughty attitude, unwillingly.

But things are different now.
As far as his fighting goes,
the #C236196003King of Heroes#CDEF stock has crashed.
Like, what's up with those stats?

I won't rest easy unless I at least mention this.
It's a matter of life or death for me, after all.

I take a deep breath, once again gather up all my courage,
look straight at #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF, and…
That wasn't the deal, you King of Zeros fraud!!!
Hmph. ―――Take a guess.

Don't "take a guess" me.
Just spill it already.

#C236196003Leo#CDEF said that #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF is an extraordinary Servant,
but if THAT'S extraordinary, then the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF market
is going to crash and make the oil crisis look like a joke.

…hmph. Ah, certainly, the details of how
I became weakened are known only to me.
I suppose I must then. Wait a moment.

At that moment, a ripple undulated in the air.
Porcelain-like objects appear.

Come now, it's simple.
Like those other Heroic Spirits,
I've manifested as a Servant.

"You will join the #C000246204Moon Cell's Holy Grail War#CDEF."
That's the situation I was placed under.

However, I was too powerful.
The #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF doesn't desire the strongest
Master, it desires the one who remains last.

The outcome would be assured with me. I was
never suited for this #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF. Thus, I
was sealed away in the #C000246204Far Side of the Moon#CDEF.

Fool. Do not lump me in with the likes of you
all. I myself entered this place.

I find it hilarious that instead of a brawl
between seven #C000246204Magi#CDEF, it's a 128-man winner-
takes-all. Briefly put, it lacks desire.

For me, the Near Side's #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF is
as tiresome as it gets. Dramas without betrayal,
schemes, or futility don't suit my taste.

Thus, I gave up on the Near Side.
The #C000246204Far Side#CDEF is a place where humanity's
malicious information is trapped――

That stagnance and murk is similar to primordial
chaos. The silence is just right. So, I made
lodge there and fell into a decadent dream.

He plunged into that sky of darkness out of his own volition…
Or, one could say that he yielded himself to a peaceful sleep.

This Servant is the recreation of a Heroic
Spirit who performed great feats.
Though his human nature is far from the norm,
this man is on a totally different level.
Sleeping within that darkness means losing one's self.

A normal Heroic Spirit would probably have to
"stay awake, never sleeping so they can maintain their self."
Yet, this man "did not harm his self while staying asleep."
Truly, he wouldn't die even if you killed him.

However, it seems that I dozed a tad too long.
After all, I DID leave my body to nil for a
millenium―no, close to an eternity.

My soul didn't fade, but it's natural that my
abilities have waned.
Such is my debilitation.

Isn't it fine, though? Thanks to that,
you were rescued. Don't they call that
a "godsend" in your country?

Endeavor to my rehabilitation with humility.
This is a good opportunity. I'll amuse myself
with feeling what it's like to be weak too.
He says, as if dumping his problem on someone else.

…I still can't get a grasp of who he really is,
but this is undoubtedly #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF's true nature.

A Heroic Spirit who flat-out rejects the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF,
calling it foolish.
No one's ally; unreliant on anyone; a self-centered Servant.

Maybe that's why he made a contract with
a novice #ROFS0001#RUBS  Magus#RUBE#C000246204Wizard#CDEF#REND like myself…

What about yourself?
Have your memories returned?

You said you lost your memories
of not only the Near Side's #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF,
but even from before joining, correct?

Of course not.
Not remembering who I am terrifies me.
It's just that this situation is too bizarre to
worry about that right now.

I see.
You want to return to the Near Side that badly?
Then, I must remind you once again.

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF.
I have no interest in the Near Side.
Escape is the objective all of YOU have.

However――Once you complete that objective,
you will perish. The very moment you return,
the curtain will fall on you.

I don't understand what that means. My one
and only hope is to return to the Near Side.
What does that have to do with death?

It's obvious. You have no #C000246204Command Seals#CDEF.
On your return, the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF will no longer
consider you a Master and will dispose of you.

Well, even without #C000246204Command Seals#CDEF, you can
continue as long as you have a Servant, but――
as I said, I won't go to the Near Side.

As a result, you'll return as a #ROFS0001#RUBS  Magus#RUBE#C000246204Wizard#CDEF#REND
with neither #C000246204Command Seals#CDEF nor a Servant.
A mere life to be ended by the next opponent.

…upon realizing it, I grip my left hand tightly,
now deprived of #C000246204Command Seals#CDEF.

I can't believe it.
NOW I've come to realize the gravity of it all.

The moment I had used up all my #C000246204Command Seals#CDEF,
I had ended up sacrificing my very life to this Servant――!

Don't look so gloomy.
This doesn't mean you are completely without
hope, you know?

For example: after returning,
you could snatch the #C000246204Command Seals#CDEF off of
other Masters and secure a new Servant.

Or, you could acquire power in this place which
surpasses mine and set me to work as a
Servant both in name and actuality.

Struggle as best you can. That sight of you
will be an appetizer I relish. I'll accompany
you until I get bored.

Naturally, I may sever the contract at any time.
Never displease me… I would normally say,
but that won't accomplish anything.

I won't demand perfection from you, a commoner.
I haven't had so much to drink that I would
order one to do what they can't do.

#C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF. I'll give you the sole
liberty to sever our contract. When you have
given up on everything, simply say the word.

When you say,
"there's nothing left for me anymore."
"There's nothing left."

While I was in that darkness,
that's the one thing I chose not to say,
even up until the very end.

He laughs, saying that the time will come
when #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF will speak those words #[he][she]# 
refused to speak.

He's not fighting for #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF's sake.
He's a demon who accepted the contract to savor
#C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF's story.

That being the case, the instant #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF
gives up, I'll become useless to him.

You loathe me well. It seems that at last
you've come into your own. You wouldn't
be worth associating with otherwise.

Now then, prepare for tomorrow and rest.
This entire affair runs deep.
It'll be difficult to survive without rest.

This is my fight only.
Flipping that logic, it also means that I
should act however I please.

…I woke up to a ringing sound, like an alarm clock.
It's a call from the Student Council Room.

Waking up after getting plenty of sleep,
I see the school is in sunset.
So this school really DOESN'T have any
concept of a day and time, it seems.

Good. I slept pleasantly. Though the small size
of this room is wanting, everything else is
generally agreeable.

Best of all is turning sides in the night and
seeing your profile. I would still be fascinated
even after staring for an entire night.

…no, this is not the time. We should be
staying focused. Let us head to the Student
Council Room, Praetor.

You awake yet?
Then let's head to the Student Council Room.

What, something bothering you?
…ah, it's this room, right? It does look
pretty lonely with the light coming in.

…there really aren't ANY pots in here…
If #C236196003Ms. Fujimura#CDEF is around, I could press her
for one or two utensils, easy.

Ah, sorry for keeping you.
Let's get a move on, Master. Knowing #C236196003Leo#CDEF,
I'm sure he already has a plan cooked up.

Hehehe. Getting up early and prepping
my darling's meal 2 hours before they wake…
such is the mark of a good wife.

So, how would you like to begin your morning?
With a meal? With a bath? Or perhaps…

Ahh! Hold on, hold on!
Why are you rushing for the door at mach speed!?

I get it! It was just a joke! Even I know when
it's time to be serious. Off now to the Student
Council Room to plan our next move, right?

Awoken, have you? It is quite an amazing
audacity you have―waking later than the king.

So, what now? Has your goal to escape from the 
#C000246204Far Side of the Moon#CDEF changed at all?

…going back to the Near Side is like returning
so I can die.

I'm aware of that. I would be lying if I said I
wasn't absolutely terrified.

―――Yet, my goal stays the same, nonetheless.
After all, I yelled out that I "won't quit,"
and I summoned this Servant.

People die sooner or later. It's only a matter of time.
So what's important isn't how long we live,
but what we leave behind―――
―――I felt my head throb.

There was something, just now.
As if I saw part of a hazy memory.

Heh. An immature ideal. However, there is value
in seeing it, from a philosophical point of
view. Do not let it become but a brave face.

Good. Then do as you say. I will not ask to
confirm again. You may go ahead and drown in
those ideals of yours.

Look, a summons from the Student Council Room.
They must have completed the labyrinth analysis.
Why not make an inquiry into that red woman?
It seems like he's in somewhat of a good mood this morning.

We withdrew from the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF
and returned to My Room.

I extracted #C236196003Rin#CDEF's hidden #C000246204SG#CDEF.
We drove #C236196003Rin#CDEF back, but she vanished like a phantom.

…it looks like it took more energy than I
expected to search this unfamiliar Labyrinth.
The moment I laid down, a rapid sleep fell over me.

#C236196003#SVT#CDEF let out a long sigh too,
as if breathing out the fatigue.

…wait.
Could it be that #C236196003#SVT#CDEF feels sad rather than tired…?

…pardon me, Master. Since my power does not
recover, I brought us into such a perilous
predicament.

I am twofold frustrated. If we were our
previous selves, we would have handily swatted
away such a Servant!

Sorry. It's about my ineptitude, Master.
How could my strength have fell so much…?
It's just plain sad, if I say so myself.

I apologize, Darling… I was negligent. It
appears that I was overly optimistic despite
knowing I was in a weakened state.

How could that lizard girl have made my Master
feel such disgrace!? My frustration is enough
to make another tail pop out!
I said this, frankly: "No, I also feel frustrated."

Being helpless against #C236196003Lancer#CDEF wasn't #C236196003#SVT#CDEF's fault.
It was because #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF, as the Master,
couldn't provide enough backup and direction.
And there's also what #C236196003Rin#CDEF said.

"If I leave #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF, #[he][she]#'ll turn the tables
before I know it."

I wonder about being overestimated, but to
turn her words into truth, #C236196003#SVT#CDEF and I need to
gather more experience.

Y-yes, that does not sound bad.
Rather, it sounds good.

Memory aside, I previously was peeved about
reacquiring our skills from scratch. Now, I have
changed my mind.

From now on, be diligent in training with me.
If we are together, we can strive to flourish
more grandly than before!

…man. You were grieving over those captured
Masters, having their magic circuits stolen.
But, my Master doesn't seem that delicate.

When push comes to shove, I'll just have to
shove back with you. Now we gotta get our minds
and bodies back in shape, right, Master?

Experience!? Experience with my Darling!? Awawa!
Please wait a moment! I will Miko-make our futon
now, Tamamo-style!

I quietly rise from my seat and place my hand
on the door. I'll sleep in the Student Council
Room tonight.

But to tell the truth, I am extremely elated
about that as well.

Because, the "acquisition of skills" means that
in sickness or in a pinch, we shall fight
together, does it not?

Yes. That is precisely the teamwork of a married
couple! No matter how many times we repeat this,
I personally feel happy!

…wait, huh? Basically, is this not like being
newly-wed again? Could it be that I am a super
winner?

…
I never really understand what #C236196003Caster#CDEF says or does,
but since we've never been married, won't she just
be getting tricked?

As a Master, although it's imperative that I get
my abilities back, bringing back my forgotten
memories is still also important.

If my memories are also my "concealed heart,"
we could work things out quickly if they take
the same shape as an #C000246204SG#CDEF, like with #C236196003Rin#CDEF.

#C000246204SG#CDEF, huh… You likely will not produce such a
thing; for you see, you are poor at secrecy.

Forget about that, will you? As far as I
remember, you had a lot of worries, but were
the type that couldn't keep a secret, see.

Ah, errr… My Darling has no #C000246204SG#CDEF, or, how should
I put it… Honestly, it is like, even if you
kept a secret, it would be obvious what it is.

"I have no secrets"…
Since I can't even remember those secrets,
it sounds pretty obvious.

Of course not. I am naught but secrets. Half of
my life was a struggle for power―mixing
secret plots with lust. To you, I… no.

Because it is you, there is much I cannot say.
A secret is the maiden's weakness, frightened
by love. If you're a proper #[man][woman]#, know this.

Well, honestly, I have but three of them.
Whether I divulge them or not depends on this
adventure. I look forward to it, Praetor.

Actually, I do have some. I am a Heroic Spirit
after all, albeit a minor one. I have plenty of
guilt for my past.

But it's fine if I don't tell you about them,
right? I don't really want to, either.

Well―――if you're lucky, there may be a
chance to teach you a life lesson thing or two.
I'm praying it doesn't happen, though.

A-a-absolutely! That is most correct! If I may:
I, #C236196003Caster#CDEF, carry no falsehoods, and am wholly
devoted to serving my Darling… Hoho!

Hohoho… hoho… Gwaah! I cannot do this after
all! Please do not look upon me with such
innocence!

I could foist one or two, well actually, a
thousand or a hundred-million or so. However, I
cannot readily divulge them.

I, too, have pride, as a woman. As long as you
do not unleash your mighty hunk powers on me,
I am sorry, but I will never tell.

…if you do come to see my secrets,
please be well and thoroughly prepared.

Really, it might be more correct to say "had."
I wonder how much about #C236196003#SVT#CDEF my past self knew.

I need to reconfirm them again,
through this battle―――

We withdrew from the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF
and returned to My Room.

I extracted #C236196003Rin#CDEF's hidden #C000246204SG#CDEF.
We drove #C236196003Rin#CDEF back, but she vanished like a phantom.

…it looks like it took more energy than I
expected to search this unfamiliar Labyrinth.
The moment I laid down, a rapid sleep fell over me.

#C236196003#SVT#CDEF also sits in his chair listlessly,
with eyes looking half open.

…wait.
Could it be that #C236196003#SVT#CDEF feels sad rather than tired…?

…however, things are not well. I felt in
rapture from becoming one of the weak, but this
is simply too much.

Being pushed about the entire time by such a
third-rate Servant is… unbearingly
disappointing of me.

His long sleep definitely enfeebled his body,
but the core of this issue lies with my inadequacy.

We were helpless against #C236196003Lancer#CDEF
because #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF couldn't
provide enough backup and direction.

I scold myself; before I get my memories back,
I need to retrain my body.
And there's also what #C236196003Rin#CDEF said.

"If I leave #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF, #[he][she]#'ll turn the tables
before I know it."

I wonder about being overestimated,
but to turn those words into truth,
#C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF and I need to gather more experience.

Fool. How many times must I tell you not to
consider us as on the same level? You have
tremendous hubris.

My recovery and your growth are separate things.
Do not dream of such things as "fighting
together." Enough absurdities.
I become terrified again.

Compared to the gaze of these red eyes,
#C236196003Lancer#CDEF's bloodlust is much lovelier.

Mongrel. Hold that light tongue of yours.
If you were a retainer of mine, I would be
beheading you. However―――

I have descended from my Gorgeous throne and am
now but a #RUBSnormal#RUBEmere#REND king. I shall generously forgive
such disrespect. Hang up a picture of kind me.

And anyway, if you descend from the throne,
doesn't that make you not a king anymore?
What on Earth is this "Gorgeous" and "Normal" stuff?

Still, it is good that you reflected and
attributed failure not due to your Servant, but
due to your own inadequacy.

That is your strong point. Your disposition
towards constantly asking questions is menial,
but you are also discerningly humble.

Is this what they call "submissive"? What that 
#C236196003Lancer#CDEF said was correct. It Gorgeously stirs up
one's sadistic inclinations.
Hm? Did you say something?

I shake my head in denial, "nuh uh."
As if I want to deal with such a dangerous
template as his.

This person is carrying secrets.
If I can bring them to light,
I should be able to understand
this Servant on a deeper level…

The #C000246204SG#CDEF, or whatnot? I have no past in need of a
burial, but I do carry as many secrets as there
are stars in the sky.

A king is one who gathers pleasures from all
over the world. I lack not in love affairs.
Still, none of it should the people hear of.

That is what I tired of that, too. "Too much of
a good thing," and such. They are not things to
be spoken of proudly.

After all, others recite the king's legend. If
you are not greatly deluded, then believe that
I will not speak of them, myself.

Though it seems #C236196003#SVT#CDEF has an #C000246204SG#CDEF as well, I may as well
try to catch a star than ask them to talk
about it.
Access to #C236196003#SVT#CDEF's #C000246204SG#CDEF granted.
To draw out your Servant's secrets,
it's essential to develop your relationship.
In My Room, be active in developing
your relationship with your Servant.

A second #C000246204SG#CDEF from #C236196003Rin#CDEF as well, huh…
And Money Worship, no less.
Such a cute face and greasy fetishes.

Currency itself has no intrinsic value. Likely,
functional "gold" cannot be created until a
country establishes its open trust in it.

Well, #C236196003Rin#CDEF may be a little different, though. She
does not indulge herself; she seems to trust…
admire money for its worth to her heart.

Yes. She cannot avoid being criticized for her
greed, but it is quite fitting to say that #C236196003Rin#CDEF
always puts the cart before the horse.

#C236196003Rin#CDEF's dream, in the end, may be for a bathtub
of rolled bills. She is a woman who wants―
will be swimming in money.

According to a theory, the concept of economics
was developed not by men, but by women,
apparently.

Especially when it comes to extravagance:
women wish to thoroughly rationalize it.

Not counting necessary expenditures in daily
life, they seem to loathe wasting money
on hobbies.

Basically, it's in a man's nature to waste; it's
in a woman's to save, you could say. Hm?
Why am I talking about all this, you ask?

Being a married man is tough. It's incredibly
painful to be held by the wallet. In that
regard, just be prepared, is what I mean.

…well, err, you know. I'm not saying that #C236196003Rin
Tohsaka#CDEF isn't the only one who's strange, but…
Look. If you're a girl, please overlook this.

A diary under the bed,
a secret video folder on a hard drive,
a miracle poem from middle school days…

The day an acquaintance―one even considered a
rival―sees these, the only options are to kill
them or move to a land far, far away.

This may be sudden, but I will speak to you
of what currency is. Mongrel.
Settle yourself and listen diligently.

Right after we returned to our room,
#C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF started talking with a haughty attitude.

…I've gotten used to the unbelievable.
These sorts of developments don't seem so
strange anymore.

Money is but a system. Standard values, ways to
circulate, ways to preserve worth. That which
has these functions can be called currency.

A myriad of ideas, cultures, arts, and great
treasures are born, not because currency itself
is wealth, but by the system of exchange――

That is known as "wealth." Many have lost
sight of this original intent, and speak filth:
of accumulating mere "peace of mind."

However――Rarely. Only rarely, there are also
connoisseurs who have understood what wealth is,
and currency, and are partial to it.

I take it upon myself to conclude that it is a
high class taste, characteristic of one who
resides in a city-state managed by money.

I do not mean, "gain authority through riches."
Truly feel the world by burying that desire,
money. Burden yourself with a greater duty.

Like how a city-state's ruler would. A mount of
piled bills is also the dew upon the city. While
glaring, transfix on the city's future path…

That woman is exactly that. She is noteworthy,
despite her foolish wretchedness. Does it not
make you want to permit her various insults?

#C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF gives a stifled laugh.
It sounds like #C236196003Rin#CDEF made a good
impression on him.

We obtained the first #C000246204SG#CDEF. The "#C000246204Desire to
Control#CDEF" is another peculiar preference.
But the real problem is #C236196003Lancer#CDEF.

To be beautiful forever, huh? Any person, no,
anyone woman would think about this
at some point…

She won't permit it otherwise.
She can't live otherwise.
She doesn't know how else to live, I think.

Ah, don't get me wrong. I don't intend on taking
her side. If we end up fighting, I'll beat her
down without any reservations.

We safely extracted her first #C000246204SG#CDEF. She claimed
to have no secrets, but this means that #C236196003Rani#CDEF's
a girl too, as we can see.
But… the problem here is #C236196003Lancer#CDEF.

She's a demon infatuated only with her own
desires. No need to hesitate beating and 
exterminating her.

…but you know, we're partly to blame.
To us guys, stuff like "being beautiful forever"
is nothing more than a selfish desire.

That said, this is a struggle to survive.
Listen here, #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. Don't be fettered by
that appearance of hers.

We safely extracted her first #C000246204SG#CDEF. She claimed
to have no secrets, but this means that #C236196003Rani#CDEF's
a girl too, as we can see.

But the problem here is #C236196003Lancer#CDEF. I'll tell you
one thing. There's no poor support here, Master.

I'm talking about you. Behind that prim face of
yours, you may be thinking something like,
"I want to try listening to #C236196003Lancer#CDEF."

Please spare me from hearing something like
that you sympathize with her as a fellow woman.

Also, aren't words like [forever beautiful]
just ill-natured fantasy? As I see it, girls
who get excited by this are to be pitied.

We got one of the embarrassing secrets
#C236196003Rani#CDEF can't tell people♪ Here's hoping for
more amusing #C000246204SGs#CDEF from now on～

…however, our current issue is that lizard
woman. Like me, she may be an anti-Heroic Spirit
considered a threat to other people, but――

…and anyway, how long is she going to act like
a girl who's always dreaming about things like
"being beautiful forever"?

That means being beautiful up until one's very
death. Looks like that princess needs a #RUBS brutal#RUBEteensy#REND
re-education.

But… with our current fighting strength,
we can't possibly stand up to a #C236196003Lancer#CDEF who
goes all out.

…it all comes back to this dress. I rather
like the design, but there's no reason to be
wearing restraint gear forever.

We're in a spot where we don't know what will
jump out at us next. For now I just about want
